#          front of a student or a teacher?

#   gen-ind  yes, indirectly: it is packaged pedagogy (a skill, a schema, an MCP
#            tutor surface) whose output is produced by the host agent
#   gen-cond yes, but only with an optional module enabled
#   pack     it does not generate, but it is where generated content BECOMES the
#            course the student opens -- the place to mark, if you mark anywhere
#   no       it moves, records, grades, roster-syncs or proctors; it does not generate
